name: Relay Console
subtitle: Your AI agents, everywhere
promotionalText: Chat with Hermes Agent and OpenClaw from iPhone or iPad. Relay keeps your workspace in sync while your runtime host is online.
description:
Relay Console gives you one clear place to talk to and manage your AI agents across your devices.

Use the iPhone and iPad app to:

• Continue conversations from your Mac or web browser
• Send messages to Hermes Agent and OpenClaw
• See whether the computer running an agent is online
• Review conversations, files, tasks and approvals
• Connect supported applications through the Marketplace
• Keep your Relay workspace in sync across devices

Relay Console is an interface for AI agent runtimes. You install and manage your chosen runtime on your own Mac, PC, Mac mini or VPS, connect the Relay bridge, and keep that computer online whenever you want the agent to respond. Relay does not install or host Hermes Agent or OpenClaw.

The iPhone and iPad app requires a Relay subscription. Relay is $9.99 per month in the US storefront, with the local App Store price shown before purchase. There is no introductory trial. You can cancel in your App Store subscription settings.

Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, model providers and connected applications are independent third-party services. Their own accounts, charges, terms and availability may apply.

exportCompliance.ownerAction: Run Apple's export-compliance question flow and obtain the responsible owner's answer before setting ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption or attaching documentation.

appleToolchain.requirement: Build App Store uploads with Xcode 26 or later and an iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 SDK.
appleToolchain.localEvidence: Xcode 26.3 is installed; release evidence must still bind the exact archive toolchain.

euTraderStatus.ownerAction: Declare trader or non-trader status in App Store Connect. If distributing in the EU as a trader, verify the public address, phone number and email required by Apple.

contentRights.ownerAction: Confirm rights to the app, listing assets, runtime/provider names, connected-service content and all third-party material before submission.

loginServices.reason: Relay Console uses Relay's own email-and-password account system for its primary account and does not offer a third-party or social primary login. Reassess before adding one.

userGeneratedContent.ownerAction: Confirm the frozen app does not expose public or human-social user-generated content. If it does, add objectionable-content filtering, reporting and response, abusive-user blocking and published contact handling before submission.

thirdPartyAIConsent.evidence: Agent message flows identify the customer-operated runtime and configured AI model provider, require affirmative permission before the first agent message, and allow withdrawal in Settings.

review.notes: The review journey uses Relay with a customer-operated Hermes Agent or OpenClaw runtime. Relay Console does not install or host that runtime; its Mac, PC, Mac mini or VPS must remain online for the agent to answer. The supplied review workspace must contain synthetic data, an enrolled online test runtime and at least one test agent. Marketplace apps retain their frozen Beta or Unavailable labels until provider-authenticated acceptance passes. The Relay monthly subscription can be purchased with StoreKit 2 and restored from Settings. Account deletion is available in Settings and requires current-password confirmation.
